Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

Chapter 5 of 宋書 ✓ Translated

1
景平二年七月中，少帝廢。 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。 望體其心，勿為辭費。 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。 甲戌，發江陵。 八月丙申，車駕至京城。 [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。
In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed. The officials prepared the imperial equipage to welcome him, and he entered to assume the imperial succession. When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, the imperial seal and ribbon were presented. Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Yanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army and Duke of Jiancheng Fu Liang, General of the Left Guards Yin Jingren, Master of Ceremonies and Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Longxiang Wang Long, Colonel of the Elite Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Wang Gang, Master of Ceremonies and Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suanzhi, Gentleman Attendant-at-Large Liu Sixuan, Extraordinary Gentleman Attendant-at-Large Pan Sheng, Gentleman of the Secretariat He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Feathered Forest and Founding Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Acting Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that adversity and prosperity transform one another, and when the cycle reaches its limit change follows—this is why the Way of Heaven does not grow old, and why a dynasty's divined span remains numinous and long." In recent times the age has declined, the royal house has been in distress, and the commands of the nine domains have had nowhere to turn; the enterprise of the High Ancestor was about to fall to the ground. Relying on your foundation of deep virtue, men and spirits alike lent their aid, the altars were secured, and the living were brought to order. We respectfully consider that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty are manifest in family and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the frontier administrations. Therefore auspicious omens have come in profusion, and talismanic portents have blazed forth. The spirits of the ancestral temples have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all the people look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you. We, unworthy though we are to bear our posts at court, were privileged to fulfill your commission and have again gathered in this era of splendid brilliance, again beholding the enterprise of great peace. The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot overcome our joy, and respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial to inform you. The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been in hardship and decline, and the cycle has struck repeated adversity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state's former condition, forever longing for him, and grief and indignation mingle together. Relying on the enduring fortune of seven hundred years and on loyal and worthy assistants, adversity could thereby be turned to prosperity and Heaven and man were set in order. I am contemptibly without virtue and have been mistakenly granted the great mandate; looking back on myself I tremble with fear—how could I bear it? I shall for the time being return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men set forth what is in my heart. I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not decline on grounds of ceremony. The prefectural and district aides and clerks all styled themselves subjects and requested that placards be inscribed on the various gates, all according to palace regulations; the Emperor did not permit it. On the jiaxu day, he set out from Jiangling. On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital. [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and there assumed the imperial throne.
2
元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。
On the dingyou day of the eighth month of autumn in the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia. Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again. On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province. On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was given the additional title of Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to General Who Campaigns against the North. On the jiachen day, his birth mother, Lady Hu the Brilliant Consort, was posthumously honored as empress dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang. Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army and was created Prince of Jiangxia. The sixth imperial younger brother Yixuan was created Prince of Jingling, and the seventh imperial younger brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang. On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Director of the Central Army. On the jiyou day, this year's tax cloth in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
3
九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。
On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as empress.
4
二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。
In the first month of spring of the second year, on the bingyin day, Minister over the Masses Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted a memorial returning government to the throne; the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs. On the xinwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed.
5
三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。
On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.
6
夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。
On the wuyin day of the fifth month in summer, Special Grandee Xie Dan died.
7
秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。
On the jiashen day of the eighth month in autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had come out to the Han River valley, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Fengyi were established. On the yiyou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand General with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
8
冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。
On the guiyou day of the eleventh month in winter, Yang Xuan, former General of the Van, was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.
9
三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。 大赦天下。 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。
In the first month of spring of the third year, on the bingyin day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were found guilty and executed. The Director of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were dispatched to campaign against Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western expedition. A general amnesty was proclaimed. On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, became Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, became Governor of Southern Xu Province. On the jisi day, Zhao Lunzhi, former General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.
10
閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。
On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
11
二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。 [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。 是日，車駕發京師。 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。
On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners awaiting judgment and convicts in exile were entirely pardoned. On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of the Golden Chariot and Purple Canopy, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was found guilty and executed. [3] On the gengshen day, Special Grandee Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grandee of Splendid Virtue. That day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital. On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji. On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned back from Wuhu. On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.
12
三月辛巳，車駕還宮。
On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
13
夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。 可遣大使巡行四方。 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。
On the yiwei day of the fifth month in summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province. On the wuxu day, Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Rear, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province. On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Prince of Northern Liang and Governor of Liang Province, was redesignated General of Chariots and Cavalry. An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends the four kinds of hearing, yet still tours the mountains and inspects the regions, gathering wind and observing government. By this means truth and falsehood are surely examined, the remote and secluded are not blocked, royal favor is not obstructed, and the nine marshes have those who hear. I, being few and thin, have contemptibly succeeded to the great succession. Although I forever bear the way of governance in mind and my purpose rests before dawn, and though I would speak of Fu Yue's cliff and rise in thought at midnight, yet the excellence of hill and garden, talents still unrevealed, the feelings of the people and what is hidden from view, still stand apart from sight and hearing. Therefore I turn my regard to the regions and cease sleep and forget meals. Now the baleful vapors have been swept away and the realm within the four seas is tranquil; to raise the worthy and extend transformation begins from this. Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters. Those prefects and magistrates who are worthy in office, and good men of humble gate or single recommendation, are to be reported in full detail in memorials, and nothing is to be omitted. If in criminal cases there is no compassion, or in government there is deviation and error, or if the people are harmed and teaching injured, report the matter in full. The elderly, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves may be generously relieved and provided for together with the commanderies and counties. Broadly gather popular reports, widely receive excellent counsel, and strive to exhaust the intent of your commission, as if I were personally reviewing it. On the bingwu day, the Emperor attended at the Hall of Extended Worthies to hear cases.
14
六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。 丙子，又聽訟。 以右衞王華為中護軍。
On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and Director of the Army. On the bingyin day, the Emperor again attended at the Hall of Extended Worthies to hear cases. On the bingzi day, he again heard cases. Wang Hua of the Right Guards was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.
15
冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。
On the wuyin day of the eleventh month in winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
16
十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。
On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman of the Secretariat, was appointed Governor of Qing Province. On the renxu day, Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
17
四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。
On the first day of the first month of spring of the fourth year, yihai, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital. On the xinsi day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
18
二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。
On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
19
三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣； 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。 」丁亥，車駕還宮。 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。
On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is intimately bound to the silkworm and mulberry of our native place; the great enterprise began there; treading that territory awakens everlasting feeling, and touching it moves me beyond measure. Formerly when Emperor Zhang of Han made his southern tour he added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when affection and righteousness are doubled and redoubled, surpassing those former days. I think to spread the lingering beneficence and repay and comfort the gentry and people. Let this county be exempted from this year's rent and cloth; all punishments of five years or less are entirely remitted; those who fought three battles in storming the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate. On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace. On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died. On the renyin day, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Qianzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.
20
夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。
On the gengxu day of the fourth month in summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
21
五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥； 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。
On the renwu day of the fifth month, Wang Hua, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died. An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine; those who died and had no family were given coffins.
22
六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。
On the first day of the sixth month, guimao, there was a solar eclipse. On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of the Golden Chariot and Purple Canopy, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.
23
五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。
On the yihai day of the first month of spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities; seeking it in human affairs, in waking and sleeping alike I have only worry. Moreover, in recent times yin and yang have violated their sequence, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to the disaster warnings, the blame lies deep in me. I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on cases and examine punishments in detail, above to answer Heaven's reproof, below to comfort the people's afflictions. The hundred officials at all ranks are each to present loyal words, pointing out gains and losses, and are not to hold anything back. On the jiashen day, the Emperor attended at the Black Tortoise Hall to review martial exercises. On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.
24
夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。
On the jihai day of the fourth month in summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province. On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
25
五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。
On the jimao day of the fifth month, Zhang Shao, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
26
六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。
On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Minister over the Masses Wang Hong was demoted to General of the Guard with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes. Great floods struck the capital; on the yimao day, [4] envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief. Cheng Daohui, Administrator of Jiangxia, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
27
秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。
On the renxu day in the eighth month of autumn, Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue Fan Tai died.
28
冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。
On the jiachen day in the tenth month of winter, the Emperor heard legal cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies.
29
閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。
On the guiwei day of the intercalary month, Liu Dewu, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Yu Province. On the xinmao day, Zhou Jizhi, chief administrator of the Duchy of Anlu, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.
30
十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。
On the gengyin day of the twelfth month, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and General Who Leads the Army Zhao Lunzhi died.
31
是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。
That year, Tianzhu sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
32
六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。 [5]
On the xinchou day of the first month in spring of the sixth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb. On the guichou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, while retaining the posts of General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province. Editorial footnote marker 5 in the source text.
33
三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。
On the dingsi day of the third month, the imperial son Shao was installed as crown prince. On the wuwu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were promoted one rank. On the xinyou day, Yin Jingren, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Director of the Central Army.
34
夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。
On the guihai day in the fourth month of summer, Wang Jinghong, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section, became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, Governor of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Section; and Jiang Yi, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section.
35
五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。
On the first day of the fifth month, renchen, there was a solar eclipse. On the gisi day, newly appointed Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jinghong was made Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue. On the jiawu day, Liu Daoji, Senior Clerk of the Pacification Army, was appointed Governor of Yi Province. On the yimao day, the commandery of Fengyi was established within Yong Province.
36
七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。
On the jiyou day of the seventh month, Kong Mozhi, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Governor of Guang Province. That month, the king of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
37
九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。
On the wuwu day of the ninth month, the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.
38
冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。
On the renshen day in the tenth month of winter, Director of the Central Army Yin Jingren left office to observe mourning for a parent.
39
十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。
On the first day of the eleventh month, jichou, there was a solar eclipse.
40
十二月丁亥，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。 [6]
On the dinghai day of the twelfth month, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys bearing tribute goods. Editorial footnote marker 6 in the source text.
41
七年春正月癸巳，以吐谷渾慕容璝為征西將軍、沙州刺史。 是月，倭國王遣使獻方物。
On the gisi day of the first month in spring of the seventh year, Murong Gui of the Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Shazhou. That month, the king of Wa sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
42
三月戊子，遣右將軍到彥之北伐，水軍入河。 甲午，以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史。 [7]甲寅，以前中領軍殷景仁為領軍將軍。
On the wuzi day of the third month, Dao Yanzhi, General of the Right, was sent north on campaign, and the fleet entered the Yellow River. On the jiawu day, Yin Chong, former Senior Clerk of the General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Inspector of Sizhou. [7] On the jiayin day, former Director of the Central Army Yin Jingren was appointed General Who Leads the Army.
43
夏四月癸未，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
On the guiwei day in the fourth month of summer, Karahoton sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
44
六月己卯，以冠軍將軍氐楊難當為秦州刺史。
On the jimao day of the sixth month, the Di chieftain Yang Nandang, General of Valiant Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Qin Province.
45
秋七月戊子，索虜碻磝戍棄城走。 丙申，以平北諮議參軍甄法護為梁、南秦二州刺史。 戊戌，索虜滑臺戍棄城走。 甲寅，林邑國、訶羅陁國、師子國遣使獻方物。
On the wuzi day in the seventh month of autumn, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and withdrew. On the bingshen day, Zhen Fahu, Consulting Colonel of the Army Who Pacifies the North, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On the wuxu day, the Suolu garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and withdrew. On the jiayin day, Linyi, Karahoton, and Shizi sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
46
冬十月甲寅，罷南豫州并豫州。 以左將軍竟陵王義宣為徐州刺史。 戊午，立錢署，鑄四銖錢。 戊寅，金墉城為索虜所陷。
On the jiayin day in the tenth month of winter, Southern Yu Province was abolished and incorporated into Yu Province. Prince of Jingling Yixuan, General of the Left, was appointed Governor of Xu Province. On the wuwu day, a mint was established and four-zhu coins were cast. On the wuyin day, Jinyong fell to the Suolu.
47
十一月癸未，虎牢城復為索虜所陷。 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟北討，右將軍到彥之自滑臺奔退。
On the guiwei day of the eleventh month, Hulao again fell to the Suolu. On the renchen day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji was sent north on a punitive campaign, while General of the Right Dao Yanzhi fled in retreat from Huatai.
48
十二月辛酉，以南兗州刺史長沙王義欣為豫州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為司州刺史。 乙亥，京邑火，延燒太社北牆。 兗州刺史竺靈秀有罪伏誅。
On the xinyou day of the twelfth month, Prince of Changsha Yixin, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province, and Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Sizhou. On the yihai day, fire broke out in the capital and spread to the north wall of the Altar of Soil and Grain. Zhu Lingxiu, Inspector of Yan Province, was found guilty and executed.
49
八年春正月庚寅，於交州復立珠崖郡。 癸巳，以左軍將軍申宣為兗州刺史。 丁酉，征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張。 [8]
On the gengyin day of the first month in spring of the eighth year, the commandery of Zhuya was re-established in Jiao Province. On the gisi day, Shen Xuan, General of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province. On the dingyou day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji defeated the Suolu at Shouzhang in Dongping. Editorial footnote marker 8 in the source text.
50
二月乙卯，以平北司馬韋朗為青州刺史。 戊午，以尚書右僕射江夷為湘州刺史。 辛酉，滑臺為索虜所陷。 癸酉，征南大將軍檀道濟引軍還。 丁丑，青州刺史蕭思話棄城走。 以太子右衞率劉遵考為南兗州刺史。
On the yimao day of the second month, Wei Lang, Senior Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies the North, was appointed Inspector of Qing Province. On the wuwu day, Jiang Yi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Right Section, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province. On the xinyou day, Huatai fell to the Suolu. On the guiyou day, General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji withdrew his army. On the dingchou day, Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Qing Province, abandoned the city and fled. Liu Zunkao, Leader of the Right Guards of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
51
三月甲申，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。 戊申，詔曰：「自頃軍役殷興，國用增廣，資儲不給，百度尚繁。 宜存簡約，以應事實。 內外可通共詳思，務令節儉。」
On the jiashen day of the third month, the Emperor heard legal cases at the Hall of Extended Worthies. An edict said: "Of late military campaigns have multiplied and state expenditures have swollen; reserves no longer suffice and government remains overburdened. Simplicity and restraint should be maintained to match what the times require. Within and beyond the court all should deliberate together and strive for thrift."
52
夏四月甲寅，以衡陽王師阮萬齡為湘州刺史。 乙卯，以後軍參軍徐遵之為兗州刺史。
On the jiayin day in the fourth month of summer, Ruan Wanling, Tutor to the Prince of Hengyang, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province. On the yimao day, Xu Zunzhi, Senior Clerk of the Rear Army, was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.
53
六月乙丑，大赦天下。 己卯，割江南及揚州晉陵郡屬南徐州，江北屬兗州。 以徐州刺史竟陵王義宣為南兗州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為徐州刺史。
On the yichou day of the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed. On the jimao day, the Jiangnan region and Jinling commandery in Yang Province were placed under Southern Xu Province, and the territory north of the river was placed under Yan Province. Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Inspector of Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Southern Yan Province; Ji Han, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Xu Province.
54
閏月庚子，詔曰：「自頃農桑惰業，遊食者眾，荒萊不闢，督課無聞。 一時水旱，便有罄匱，苟不深存務本，[9]豐給靡因。 郡守賦政方畿，縣宰親民之主，宜思奬訓，導以良規。 咸使肆力，地無遺利，耕蠶樹藝，各盡其力。 若有力田殊眾，歲竟條名列上。 」揚州旱。 乙巳，遣侍御史省獄訟，申調役。 丙午，以左軍諮議參軍劉道產為雍州刺史。
An edict said: "Of late farming and sericulture have languished; wanderers living off others are numerous; wasteland lies unreclaimed, and supervisory duties go unreported. A single season of flood or drought brings destitution; unless the fundamental work of the land is deeply upheld, [9] plenty cannot be secured. Prefects govern the metropolitan districts; magistrates are masters closest to the people—they should reflect on how to encourage and instruct them, guiding them with sound policies. All should be set to their labor so that no land lies idle; in plowing, sericulture, and planting each should give full effort. Those with outstanding achievement in cultivation should, when the year ends, be listed by name and reported upward." Yang Province suffered drought. On the yisi day, attendant censors were dispatched to review prison cases and adjust corvée obligations. On the bingwu day, Liu Daochan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
55
秋八月甲辰，臨川王義慶解尚書僕射。 丁未，割豫州秦郡屬南兗州。
On the jiachen day in the eighth month of autumn, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. On the dingwei day, Qin commandery in Yu Province was placed under Southern Yan Province.
56
冬十二月，罷湘州還并荊州。
In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and reincorporated into Jing Province.
57
九年春三月庚戌，衞將軍王弘進位太保，加中書監。 丁巳，征南大將軍、江州刺史檀道濟進位司空。
On the gengxu day of the third month in spring of the ninth year, General of the Guard Wang Hong was promoted to Grand Tutor and additionally appointed Supervisor of the Masters of Writing. On the dingsi day, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.
58
夏四月乙亥，以護軍將軍殷穆為特進、右光祿大夫，建昌縣公到彥之為護軍將軍。
On the yihai day in the fourth month of summer, Yin Mu, General Who Protects the Army, was made Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue; Dao Yanzhi, Duke of Jianchang, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.
59
五月壬申，中書監、錄尚書事、衞將軍、揚州刺史王弘薨。
On the renshen day of the fifth month, Wang Hong, Supervisor and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, General of the Guard, and Governor of Yang Province, died.
60
六月甲戌，以左軍諮議參軍申宣為青州刺史。 分青州置冀州。 戊寅，司徒、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改領揚州刺史。 己卯，以司徒參軍崔諲為冀州刺史。 壬午，以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍，[10]吐谷渾拾虔為平北將軍，吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍。 [11]癸未，詔曰：「益、梁、交、廣，境域幽遐，治宜物情，或多偏擁。 可更遣大使，巡求民瘼。 」置積射、強弩將軍官。 乙未，以征西將軍、沙州刺史吐谷渾慕容璝為征西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史、隴西王。 北秦州刺史氐楊難當加號征西將軍。 壬寅，以撫軍將軍、荊州刺史江夏王義恭為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，前將軍臨川王義慶為平西將軍、荊州刺史，南兗州刺史竟陵王義宣為中書監、中軍將軍，征虜將軍衡陽王義季為南徐州刺史。
On the jiaxu day of the sixth month, Shen Xuan, Consulting Colonel of the Left Army, was appointed Inspector of Qing Province. Ji Province was established by partitioning Qing Province. On the wuyin day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Yang Province. On the jimao day, Cui Yin, Senior Clerk of the Minister over the Masses, was appointed Inspector of Ji Province. On the renwu day, Murong Yan of the Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the East; [10] Shiqian of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the North; and Huifa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army. An edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang lie in distant borderlands; administration should accord with local conditions, yet in many places power is held in narrow, selfish hands. Let great envoys again be sent forth to tour the regions and inquire into the people's hardships." The posts of General of Volley-Shooters and General of Strong Crossbows were established. On the yiwei day, Murong Gui of the Tuyuhun, General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Shazhou, was appointed General Who Campaigns West, Governor of Western Qin and He provinces, and Prince of Longxi. Yang Nandang of the Di, Inspector of Northern Qin Province, was additionally granted the title General Who Campaigns West. On the renyin day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Yan Province; Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Front, became General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jingling Yixuan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army; and Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
61
秋七月戊辰，以尚書王仲德為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。 庚午，以領軍將軍殷景仁為尚書僕射，太子詹事劉湛為領軍將軍。 壬申，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。 [12]
On the wuchen day in the seventh month of autumn, Wang Zhongde of the Masters of Writing was appointed General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of Xu Province. On the gengwu day, General Who Leads the Army Yin Jingren was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Liu Zhan, Grand Master of the Heir Apparent, was made General Who Leads the Army. On the renshen day, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys bearing tribute goods. Editorial footnote marker 12 in the source text.
62
九月，妖賊趙廣寇益州，陷沒郡縣，州府討平之。
In the ninth month, the sorcerer-rebel Zhao Guang raided Yi Province, overrunning commanderies and counties; the provincial government defeated and pacified him.
63
冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。
On the renzi day of the eleventh month of winter, Zhen Fachong, Director of the Palace Treasury, was appointed Governor of Yi Province. On the guichou day, the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.
64
十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。
On the chia-hsü day of the twelfth month, Li Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province. On the keng-yin day, the fifth imperial son Shao was created Prince of Lu-ling, and Lang, son of Prince of Chiang-hsia I-chung, was created Prince of Nan-feng County.
65
十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。 己未，大赦天下。 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。
In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the chia-yin day, Prince of Ching-ling I-hsuan was redesignated Prince of Nan-ch'iao. Wang Chung-te, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yen Province; Tuan Hung, Administrator of Huai-nan, became Governor of Ch'ing Province. On the chi-wei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed. The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain. Prince of Ch'ang-sha I-hsin, General of the Rear and Governor of Yü Province, was advanced to General of the Army.
66
夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。
On the wu-hsü day of the fourth month in summer, Tuan Hung, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Chi Province. Hsiao Szu-hua, Marquis of Feng-yang, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.
67
五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。
In the fifth month, the King of Lin-yi sent envoys bearing tribute.
68
六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
On the i-hai day of the sixth month, Wei Lang, former Governor of Ch'ing Province, was appointed Governor of Kuang Province. The state of Ho-lo-tan in Ch'an-p'o sent envoys bearing tribute.
69
秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。
On the wu-hsü day of the seventh month in autumn, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yi, Liang, and Ch'in provinces. The commanderies of Sung-ning and Sung-hsing were established in Yi Province.
70
八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。
On the ting-ch'ou day of the eighth month, T'ai-yüan Commandery was established in Ch'ing Province. On the hsin-ssu day, Tao Yen-chih, General Who Protects the Army, died.
71
冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。
In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nan-t'ang raided Han-ch'uan. On the ting-wei day, Chen Fa-hu, Governor of Liang Province, abandoned the city and fled, and Nan-t'ang took possession of Liang Province.
72
十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。
In the first month of spring of the eleventh year, the outlaw Ma Ta-hsüan and his band of several hundred men raided T'ai-shan; [13] the province and commanderies suppressed them.
73
二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。
On the kuei-yu day of the second month, Li Tan-chih, Administrator of Chiao-chih, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.
74
夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。
In the fourth month of summer, Hsiao Szu-hua, Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nan-t'ang, and Liang Province was pacified.
75
五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。
On the ting-mao day of the fifth month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the region north of Chien-ko in Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces. On the wu-yin day, Chu-chü Mao-ch'ien was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.
76
是月，京邑大水。
That month, the capital suffered severe flooding.
77
六月丁未，省魏郡。
On the ting-wei day of the sixth month, Wei Commandery was abolished.
78
是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
That year, Lin-yi, Fu-nan, and Ho-lo-tan sent envoys bearing tribute.
79
十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。
On the hsin-yu day of the first month in spring of the twelfth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed. On the hsin-wei day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb. On the kuei-yu day, Feng Hung, ruler of the Yellow Dragon state, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yen.
80
夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。 」是夜，京都地震。
On the i-yu day of the fourth month in summer, [14] Yin Ching-jen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was additionally appointed General of the Central Army. On the ping-ch'en day, an edict said: "The Zhou house attained peace through its many officers; the Han dynasty's rise likewise depended on finding the right men. I have long dreamed and waked with joy in worthy men, yet sage discernment remains hard to reach and bright promotion has borne no fruit. Outstanding talent still wanders beyond office, and the court's storerooms stand empty; thinking forever on the records of old, I am deeply ashamed of my own virtue. To recommend those you know is Confucius's earnest teaching; presenting scholars and appointing them to office is the settled standard of former ages. Let an edict now be proclaimed within and without, and let each office make recommendations. They shall be weighed and advanced by their measure, that we may see what use they can serve." That night, the capital was struck by an earthquake.
81
六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。 是月，斷酒。 師子國遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month, Tan-yang, Huai-nan, Wu-hsing, and I-hsing suffered severe flooding, and in the capital people went about by boat. On the chi-yu day, several million hu of grain from Hsü, Yü, and Southern Yen provinces and from K'uai-chi and Hsüan-ch'eng commanderies were distributed to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies. That month, the sale of wine was prohibited. The Lion Country sent envoys bearing tribute.
82
秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。
On the hsin-yu day of the seventh month in autumn, [15] the states of Ch'an-p'o-sa-ta and Fu-nan both sent envoys bearing tribute.
83
八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。
On the jen-shên day of the eighth month, the three commanderies of Southern Chin-shou, Southern Hsin-pa, and Northern Pa-hsi were established in Yi Province. [16] On the i-hai day, all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.
84
九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。
In the ninth month, the bandit Chang Hsün of Shu Commandery rose in rebellion.
85
冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。
In the eleventh month of winter, Ch'ü Tao-fu, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.
86
十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。
On the kuei-ch'ou day of the first month in spring of the thirteenth year, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
87
三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。 庚申，大赦天下。 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。
On the chi-wei day of the third month, Tan Tao-chi, Minister of Works and Governor of Chiang Province, was found guilty and executed. On the keng-shên day, a general amnesty was proclaimed. Prince of Nan-ch'iao I-hsuan, General of the Central Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Chiang Province.
88
夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。
On the wu-ch'en day of the fifth month in summer, Wang Chung-te, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces, was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the North. On the keng-ch'en day, Wang Fang-p'ai, Staff Officer of the General Who Campaigns North, was appointed Governor of Yen Province.
89
六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month, Kao-li and the Prince of Wu-tu sent envoys bearing tribute.
90
八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。
On the keng-yin day of the eighth month, Yin Ching-jen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Central Army, was redesignated General Who Protects the Army.
91
九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。
On the kuei-ch'ou day of the ninth month, the second imperial son Chün was created Prince of Shih-hsing, and the third imperial son Chün was created Prince of Wu-ling.
92
十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。 文武賜位一等； 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。
On the hsin-mao day of the first month in spring of the fourteenth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were promoted one rank; the elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.
93
二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。 [17]
On the jen-tzu day of the second month, Liu Chen-tao, Colonel of Footsoldiers, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces. [17] Editorial note seventeen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
94
夏四月丁未，以輔國將軍周籍之為益州刺史。
On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, Chou Chi-chih, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.
95
秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。
On the wu-wu day of the eighth month in autumn, Hsu Sen-chih, Gentleman of the Gold Section in the Masters of Writing, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.
96
冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。 [18]
On the hsin-yu day of the twelfth month in winter, the rite of congratulating on snow was suspended. The states of Ho-nan, the Prince of the Western River, and Ho-lo-tan all sent envoys bearing tribute. [18] Editorial note eighteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
97
十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。
On the ting-wei day of the second month in spring of the fifteenth year, Murong Yen of T'o-yü-hun, General Who Pacifies the East, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ch'in and Ho provinces.
98
夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。 [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。
On the chia-ch'en day of the fourth month in summer, Prince of Yen Hung sent envoys bearing tribute. [19] The consort of the Heir Apparent of the Yin clan was installed, and kings, dukes, and officials below them were each granted gifts according to rank. On the chi-ssu day, Chen, King of Wa, was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.
99
五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。
On the chi-ch'ou day, Yin Mu, Special Grandee and Right Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died. On the hsin-mao day, Wang Chung-te, Grand General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsü Province, died. On the jen-ch'en day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces.
100
秋七月辛未，地震。 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。
On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, there was an earthquake. On the chia-hsü day, Hsu Hsün, Administrator of Ch'en and Nan-tun, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.
101
八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。
On the hsin-ch'ou day of the eighth month, Chao Po-fu, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Hsü and Yen provinces. On the chia-yin day, Lu Hui, Administrator of Shih-hsing, was appointed Governor of Kuang Province. On the ting-ssu day, Wang Fang-p'ai, Governor of Yen Province, was appointed Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces.
102
是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。
That year, the Prince of Wu-tu, the state of Ho-nan, Kao-li, Wa, Fu-nan, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute.
103
十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。
On the wu-yin day of the first month in spring of the sixteenth year, the Emperor reviewed troops at the northern suburb. On the keng-yin day, Prince of P'eng-ch'eng I-k'ang, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was advanced to Grand General; he remained Minister over the Masses, and his other offices were unchanged. Prince of Chiang-hsia I-chung, General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was advanced to Minister of Works; his governorship was unchanged. Wang Ching-hung, Special Grandee and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, received the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes. On the kuei-ssu day, Ching Province was again divided to establish Hsiang Province.
104
二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。
On the chi-hai day of the second month, Prince of Heng-yang I-chi, Governor of Southern Hsü Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Ching Province. On the ting-wei day, Prince of Shih-hsing Chün was appointed Governor of Hsiang Province. On the kuei-hai day, the six commanderies of Pa-hsi, Tzu-t'ung, Southern Tang-ch'ü, Southern Han-chung from Liang Province and Nan-an and Huai-ning from Southern Ch'in Province were detached [20] and assigned to Yi Province. Pa-ling Commandery was carved out of Ch'ang-sha and Chiang-hsia commanderies and placed under Hsiang Province.
105
夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。
On the ting-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, Prince of Nan-ch'iao I-hsuan, General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Chiang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsü Province. Prince of Lin-ch'uan I-ch'ing, General Who Pacifies the West, was appointed General of the Guard and Governor of Chiang Province.
106
六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。
On the chi-yu day of the sixth month, Murong Yen of Lung-hsi T'o-yü-hun was redesignated Prince of Ho-nan. On the kuei-ch'ou day, Shih-pin of T'o-yü-hun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West, and Fan-ni of T'o-yü-hun was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.
107
秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。
On the keng-tzu day of the eighth month in autumn, the fourth imperial son Shuo was created Prince of Nan-p'ing.
108
閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。
On the i-wei day of the intercalary month, Prince of Ch'ang-sha I-hsin, General of the Army and Governor of Yü Province, died. On the wu-hsü day, Huai-nan was again severed from Yü Province to establish Southern Yü Province. On the kuei-mao day, Liu Tsun-k'ao, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Yü Province. On the wu-shên day, Prince of Shih-hsing Chün, Governor of Hsiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yü Province, and Prince of Wu-ling Chün became Governor of Hsiang Province.
109
冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。
On the i-hai day of the twelfth month in winter, the Heir Apparent underwent the capping ceremony, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
110
是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。
That year, the Prince of Wu-tu, the Prince of Ho-nan, Lin-yi, and Kao-li sent envoys bearing tribute.
111
十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。
On the wu-wu day, the first of the fourth month in summer of the seventeenth year, there was a solar eclipse.
112
五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。
On the kuei-ssu day of the fifth month, Liu Chan, General of the Army of the Palace Guard, left office to observe mourning for his mother.
113
秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。
On the renyin day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Ji, Consulting Colonel of General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Qing Province. On the renzi day, Empress Yuan of the Yuan clan died.
114
八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。
In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered severe flooding; on the jiwei day, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.
115
九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。
On the renzi day of the ninth month, the Primary Empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
116
冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。
On the wuwu day of the tenth month in winter, Liu Zhan, former Governor of Danyang, was found guilty; he and his accomplices were executed. A general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were raised one rank of nobility. Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; his title as Grand General was unchanged. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing. On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province while retaining his former title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Governor of Yang Province; his vice directorship was unchanged.
117
十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。 凡諸逋債，優量申減。 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。 山澤之利，猶或禁斷； 役召之品，遂及稚弱。 諸如此比，傷治害民。 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。
On the bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was appointed General Who Leads the Army; Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent. On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The field grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that in recent years was remitted and should have been collected and forwarded—all are reduced by half. Where there was no harvest this year, [21] all obligations are remitted. All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced. Moreover, the appraisal taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies imposed locally are in many places burdensome and harsh. The profits of mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and cut off; the categories of corvée summons extend even to the young and weak. Matters such as these injure governance and harm the people. From now on all are to follow the laws and ordinances and strive to grant full favor and allowance. If anything is inconvenient, report it separately according to the matter; do not hastily pursue momentary gain and thereby violate the intent of hidden compassion. Those in charge are clearly to proclaim this below and make known my intent." On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.
118
十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。 [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。
On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xiang Province, became Governor of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
119
是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。
That year, the Prince of Wudu, the Prince of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
120
十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。
On the yimao day of the second month in spring of the eighteenth year, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.
121
夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。 是月，沔水泛溢。
On the renwu day of the fifth month in summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both granted the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes. On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province. That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.
122
六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。
On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief. On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.
123
秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。
On the wuxu day of the seventh month in autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.
124
冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。
On the xinhai day of the tenth month in winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping commanderies, was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces. On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
125
十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。 [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。
On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died. [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yan, Governor of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
126
氐楊難當又寇漢川。 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。
The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided Han-chuan. On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to campaign against him. That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, defeated and pacified him.
127
是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。
That year, Suote, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
128
十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教； 本立化成，斆學之為貴。 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」
On the yisi day of the first month in spring of the nineteenth year, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root; this is the far-reaching teaching of the sage and wise. When the root is established, transformation takes shape; instruction and learning are held precious. Therefore one is admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to measure and standard. In flourishing kingship and sagely ages, [26] all necessarily proceed by this. At the beginning of Yongchu the mandate was received and the statutes and regulations were broadly extended, intending to shape the myriad classes and unify diverse customs; there was an edict to the responsible offices to open the schools on a great scale, yet repeatedly encountering repeated adversity, construction was not completed in time. Eternally gazing upon the former plan, I think to spread the great achievement. Now the regions are at peace and the barbarians and Chinese alike turn in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of the state is truly the task of the age. Let the established regulations now be followed and the splendid enterprise proclaimed."
129
夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。
On the jiaxu day of the fourth month in summer, because a long illness had healed, the yue sacrifice was performed for the first time; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed.
130
五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。
On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang; Chouchi was pacified.
131
閏月，京邑雨水； 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。
In the intercalary month, the capital suffered rain and flooding; On the dingsi day, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.
132
六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。
On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.
133
秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。
In the seventh month in autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On the last day of the month, jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
134
冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。
On the jiashen day of the tenth month in winter, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute goods. On the jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.
135
十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。
On the bingshen day of the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the state are beginning to gather and studies are just rising. Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by events I think of those men, and my feelings are stirred with emotion. The descendants of the Sage of Veneration may speedily deliberate succession. On the site of the former temple, a special structure is to be built; according to the old practice, an official for sacrifices is to be appointed, with offerings in the four seasons. Que-li in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school buildings were ruined; orders are also sent down to Lu Commandery to repair the school quarters and recruit students. Former worthy men and sages, and even a single act of goodness, still perhaps guarded their hill mounds and forbade grazing and cutting; how much more does the Teacher whose virtue marks all the living and whose merit covers a hundred generations have his tomb mound overgrown and brambles uncut. Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from levies to attend to sweeping and sprinkling. The leading commoners of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and four other households, dwelling near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from their tax and corvée duties, supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were additionally planted.
136
是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。
That year, Bapo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
137
二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。
In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of Terrace City the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened.
138
二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。 仇池為索虜所沒。 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。
On the jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent. On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Governor of Jiang Province. Chouchi was overrun by the Suolu. On the jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed troops at Baixia.
139
三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。
On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Grand General Who Campaigns West. Shen Tan, Administrator of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
140
夏四月甲午，立第六皇子誕為廣陵王。
On the jiawu day of the fourth month in summer, the sixth imperial son Dan was created Prince of Guangling.
141
五月癸丑，中護軍庾登之卒。
On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.
142
秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。 辛酉，以南蠻校尉蕭思話為雍州刺史。 甲子，前雍州刺史劉真道、梁南秦二州刺史裴方明有罪，下獄死。
On the guichou day of the seventh month in autumn, Yang Wende was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu. On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province. On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were found guilty; they were imprisoned and executed.
143
八月癸未，以廷尉陶愍祖為廣州刺史。
On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
144
冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。 壬午，詔曰：「國以民為本，民以食為天。 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。 倉廩既實，禮節以興。 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊； 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。 誠由政德弗孚，以臻斯弊； 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。 永言弘濟，明發載懷。 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」
On the gengwu day of the twelfth month in winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province. On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their heaven. Therefore if one man ceases sowing, hunger necessarily reaches others. When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise. Recently wherever one looks there is destitution; households have no stores overnight. When levies and corvée are for a time uneven, then the people harbor anxious distress; when the year is sometimes not abundant, sickness and want visit house after house. Truly this is because governmental virtue has not won trust, thereby bringing these ills; yet also farming and sericulture are not widely extended, and the land's profit is much left unused. Magistrates and prefects are slight in the methods of transforming and guiding; the common folk forget the meaning of diligent division of labor. Speaking forever of broad relief, at dawn my thoughts are laden. Although regulations and orders are repeatedly issued, in the end none are warned and encouraged, yet sitting and looking for increase and growth—how can that be attained? The responsible offices are to proclaim the old articles and strive to fulfill earnest instruction. Wandering idlers are all to be ordered to attach to occupations; diligence and sloth are to be examined and verified, and punishments and rewards applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced. In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial fields and respectfully supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I think to follow the established canon. Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined. I shall personally lead the hundred officials and perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and plainness may reach this people."
145
是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。
That year, Hexi, Koguryo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
146
是歲，諸州郡水旱傷稼，民大饑。 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。
That year, in the various provinces and commanderies flood and drought injured the crops, and the people suffered great famine. Envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted and distributed.
147
二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。 大赦天下。 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。 去歲失收者，疇量申減。 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。
On the jihai day of the first month in spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu Province, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River [29] all prohibited wine. A general amnesty was proclaimed. All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year were completely remitted. Where the harvest had failed the previous year, reductions were to be assessed and reported. In the most distressed districts, envoys were dispatched to the commanderies and counties to provide relief as local conditions required. All who wished to return to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally granted loans. Corvée workers in the offices overseeing the thousand-mu fields were granted cloth, each according to rank. On the wuwu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, died. On the xinyou day, Liu Yizong, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
148
二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。
On the gengwu day of the second month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Governor of Yu Province. On the jichou day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to Grand Commandant while retaining the post of Minister over the Masses. On the gengyin day, Shen Yanzhi, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Director of the Central Army. On the xinmao day, the seventh imperial son Hong was created Prince of Jianping. On the jiawu day, Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
149
夏四月，晉陵延陵民徐耕以米千斛助卹饑民。
In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling contributed a thousand hu of grain to relieve the famine-stricken.
150
五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。
On the renxu day of the fifth month, He Shangzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General of the Central Army; Liu Daoxi, Consulting Colonel, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
151
六月，連雨水。 丁亥，詔曰：「霖雨彌日，水潦為患，百姓積儉，易致乏匱。 二縣官長及營署部司，各隨統檢實，給其柴米，必使周悉。」
In the sixth month, rain fell without cease. On the dinghai day, an edict said: "Rain has fallen day after day; flooding has become a disaster, and the people, their stores grown spare, easily fall into want. The chief officials of the two counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons shall each, within their jurisdiction, inspect and verify accounts and supply firewood and grain, ensuring that nothing is left wanting."
152
秋七月丁酉，揚州刺史始興王濬加中軍將軍，南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍。 [30]乙巳，詔曰：「比年穀稼傷損，淫亢成災，亦由播殖之宜，尚有未盡。 南徐、兗、豫及揚州浙江西屬郡，自今悉督種麥，以助闕乏。 速運彭城下邳郡見種，委刺史貸給。 徐、豫土多稻田，而民間專務陸作，可符二鎮，履行舊陂，相率修立，并課墾闢，使及來年。 凡諸州郡，皆令盡勤地利，勸導播殖，蠶桑麻紵，各盡其方，不得但奉行公文而已。」
On the dingyou day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally appointed General of the Central Army; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Army. [30] On the yisi day, an edict said: "In recent years the grain harvest has suffered injury and excessive rain has brought calamity—this is also because the proper seasons for planting have not yet been fully observed. In Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the western districts of Yang Province beyond the Zhe River, all are henceforth to be directed to plant wheat to help make up what is lacking. Seed now available in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be transported at once and entrusted to the inspectors for loan and distribution. The soil of Xu and Yu has many paddy fields, yet the people devote themselves solely to dry cultivation; orders should be sent to the two garrisons to put the old embankments back in service, jointly repair and establish them, and also assign reclamation so that the work is completed by next year. In every province and commandery, all are ordered to exhaust the land's advantage, encourage planting and cultivation, and give full effort to sericulture, mulberry, hemp, and ramie each in its season—they must not merely carry out documents on paper."
153
八月戊辰，征西大將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，征北將軍、南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍、荊州刺史。 [31]南兗州刺史廣陵王誕為南徐州刺史。
On the wuchen day of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns North, Commissioner with Credentials Equal to the Three Dukes, and Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province. [31] Prince of Guangling Dan, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
154
九月甲辰，以大沮渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。
On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.
155
冬十月己卯，以左軍將軍徐瓊為兗州刺史，大將軍參軍申恬為冀州刺史。
On the jimao day of the tenth month in winter, Xu Qiong, General of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yan Province; Shen Tian, Senior Clerk of the Grand General, was appointed Governor of Ji Province.
156
二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。
On the xinmao day, the first of the first month in spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuanjia new calendar compiled by Imperial Censor He Chengtian was adopted. On the renchen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Yong Province; Prince of Nanping Shuo, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.
157
二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。
On the xinsi day of the second month, Wang Senglang, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province. On the jiaxu day, the eighth imperial son Hui was created Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang was created Prince of Yiyang.
158
夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。
On the xinhai day of the sixth month in summer, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.
159
秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。 雍州刺史武陵王駿討緣沔蠻，移一萬四千餘口於京師。 乙酉，征北大將軍、南兗州刺史衡陽王義季改為徐州刺史。
On the jiwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Kai, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; He Shangzhi, General of the Central Army, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and relocated more than fourteen thousand households to the capital. On the yiyou day, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Xu Province.
160
九月己未，[32]開酒禁。
On the jiwei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
161
冬十月，起湖熟廢田千頃。
In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.
162
十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人。 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。
On the yiwei day of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed. On the dingyou day, Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status. On the gengxu day, Zhao Bofu, former Governor of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.
163
二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。 庚申，尚書左僕射孟顗去職。 遷漢川流民於沔次。 [33]
On the dingsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Changsha, was appointed Governor of Yi Province. On the gengshen day, Meng Kai, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, resigned his post. Displaced persons from Han-chuan were resettled along the Mian. Editorial footnote marker 33 in the source text.
164
二月癸卯，以左衞將軍劉義賓為南兗州刺史。
On the guimao day of the second month, Liu Yibin, General of the Left Guards, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
165
三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。
In the third month, the Suolu raided Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, defeated them.
166
夏四月丁未，大赦天下。
On the dingwei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
167
六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。
On the guiwei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse. Tan Hezhi, Governor of Jiao Province, attacked Lin-yi and conquered it.
168
秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。
On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Tan, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.
169
八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。
On the guimao day of the eighth month, the red-painted bandits of Jieyang attacked Jian'an Commandery and burned the prefectural and commandery offices.
170
九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。
On the jimao day of the ninth month, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students by questioning, and fifty-nine answered.
171
冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。 諸生答問，多可採覽。 教授之官，並宜沾賚。 」賜帛各有差。
On the wuzi day of the tenth month in winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies. Having recently examined them in person, I beheld their flourishing assembly and, looking far back to Zhu and Si, forever cherish what is past. The students' answers in the examination may largely be adopted for review. Their instructors should all receive rewards." Silk was distributed, each according to rank.
172
十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。
On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Jingxian, Staff Officer of the Dragon-charger, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
173
是歲，大有年。 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。
That year brought a great harvest. The northern embankment was built, Xuanwu Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in Hualin Park.
174
二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。
On the jiaxu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were promoted one rank. Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; overdue obligations were leniently reduced, each according to measure. The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain. This year's land tax in Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted by half.
175
三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。
On the renshen day of the third month, Zhao Bofu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred from his post.
176
夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。
On the jiaxu day of the fifth month in summer, Du Tan, Governor of Qing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.
177
六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。
In the sixth month, plague struck the capital; on the bingxu day, the commanderies and counties and the departmental offices of the garrisons were ordered to conduct inspections throughout and supply medicine. That month, because goods had grown costly, large coins were instituted with a value of two.
178
秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。
On the yimao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as gifts, each according to rank.
179
八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。
On the yiwei day of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Xu Province, died. On the guimao day, Liu Yibin, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Xu Province.
180
九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。
On the jiwei day of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was appointed General Who Leads the Army. On the xinwei day, Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
181
冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。
On the renwu day of the tenth month in winter, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Administrator Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Governor of Jiao Province, was returning south and reached Yuzhang, whereupon he suppressed the rebellion. On the renchen day, Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed General of the Central Army.
182
十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。
On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was created Prince of Ruyin.
183
二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」
On the wuchen day of the first month in spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Of late ice and snow have lasted many days; fuel and grain have grown costly, and poor and distressed households are many in their straits. The two counties of the capital and the garrisons should be inspected and supplied with firewood and grain."
184
二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同； 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。 當因校獵，肄武講事。」
On the gengyin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one does not forget peril—this all ages hold in common; to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state. Therefore when instruction is received and shame is understood, then young and old alike know prohibition. Of late military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet orders and proclamations have not been made clear. Now that the Xuanyong training ground has just been completed, on a set day the mass of troops may be drilled on a great scale. This should be carried out by means of a hunting review, to practice arms and discuss affairs."
185
閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。
On the jiyou day of the intercalary month, a great hunt was held at the Xuanyong training ground.
186
三月庚辰，車駕校獵。
On the gengchen day of the third month, the Emperor conducted a hunting review.
187
夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。
On the yisi day of the fourth month in summer, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang. On the yimao day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province. On the guihai day, Xiao Sihua, General of the Right Guards, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
188
五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。
On the jimao day of the fifth month, the large coin valued at two was abolished.
189
六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。
On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Sima Yuanyu, Senior Clerk of the Prince of Lingling, died. On the gengshen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yan Province. On the bingyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.
190
秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。
On the renwu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Jinghong, Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, died.
191
八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。
On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Liu Xiuzhi, Consulting Colonel of the Pacification Army, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces. On the jiazi day, the eleventh imperial son Yu was created Prince of Huaiyang.
192
九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。
On the xinwei day of the ninth month, He Shangzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yanzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred from his post; Liu Zunkao, Administrator of Wuxing, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.
193
二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。
On the xinsi day of the first month in spring of the twenty-sixth year, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
194
二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。
On the jihai day of the second month, the Emperor traveled by land to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
195
三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。 其大赦天下。 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」
On the dingsi day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "For more than twenty years I have been kept from the northern capital; though men say it lies near at hand, I have had no road by which to look upon the journey home.
