Now that the realm is at peace and the seasons are harmonious and the harvest abundant, I have again been able to worship at the ancestral tombs, express boundless grief, feast the elders of former days, and voice my longing for those gone before. Thus my duty to my homeland joins with my affection, and my feeling exceeds even the emotion of passing through Pei; speaking of it ever stirs me, and my gratitude and consolation are profound indeed. Let benevolence and favor be proclaimed at once and spread throughout the realm. A general amnesty is proclaimed. Half of this year's land tax and cloth levy for Dantu county's migrant households is remitted. In the counties along the route, half the land tax is remitted. Prefects and magistrates who have diligently served the royal cause should receive rewards. Households from the three battles at Dengcheng and families of great generals killed or lost in battle, together with the aged, sick, and solitary weak, are to receive general relief. Envoys are sent to tour the districts and inquire into the people's hardships. The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those of the six infirmities unable to support themselves are each granted five hu of grain. " Envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Duke of Loyal Solemnity He Wuji. On the yichou day, tax remissions were proclaimed for the three commanderies of Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi. Another edict said: "Jingkou has been auspicious since antiquity and has borne omens in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, it is the heart of the central domain; highways reach it on every side and its profit extends to the Huai and the sea; its cities are lofty and its customs pure; gathering every strategic advantage, it is truly a famous capital. Therefore it could illuminate the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to success. In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth and soldiers and civilians have been scattered; the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days. As the old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory weighty among the domains, it should be made prosperous and its outward dignity exalted. Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remissions."
196
五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。
On the bingyin day of the fifth month, an edict said: "I was born in this city. When Lu Xun wreaked havoc, harm flowed through this region. The late Emperor, because this was the root of the mulberry homeland and truly shared weal and woe, and because I was still young and undeservedly shared the hardships, our bond of righteousness was close and we endured peril together; traces of old things still remain before my eyes. The years do not stay; more than three decades have passed, and the people and elders of that time have fallen away with fate. Looking back on what is past, my feeling of deep sighing is doubled. Search out civil and military gentlemen of that time, common and official, who still survive today, and report all their names. If the person himself has died but sons and grandsons survive, favor them generously with gifts." The Emperor set out from Dantu by water; on the renwu day he reached the capital. On the bingxu day, the state of Bapo; on the renchen day, the state of Bada—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
197
秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。
On the xinwei day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
198
八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。
On the jiyou day, Prince of Pingling Hong, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province. On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
199
冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。
In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was reassigned as Prince of Suixiang. On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Yang Province.
200
二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。
On the xinwei day of the first month in spring of the twenty-seventh year, Jiao and Ning provinces were ordered to grant acting commission seals to commandery and county officials; salaries were to follow central appointment. On the xinmao day, the state of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
201
二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。
On the xinchou day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West. On the xinhai day, [35] the Suolu raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled. The Suolu attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, Acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them. Because of military exigency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.
202
三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。 戊寅，罷國子學。 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。
On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the inner court officials; thereupon prefectures and commanderies, and assistant magistrates and commandants, were all likewise reduced. On the wuyin day, the National University was abolished. On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.
203
夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。 [36]
In the fourth month of summer on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Garrisons the Army. Editorial footnote marker 36 in the source text.
204
六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。
In the sixth month on the dingyou day, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
205
秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。
In the seventh month of autumn on the gengwu day, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, was dispatched on the northern campaign. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand General, advanced and encamped at Pengcheng to command all the armies. On the yihai day, the Suolu garrison at Qiuyao abandoned the city and withdrew.
206
冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。 丙戌，又克關城。
In the intercalary month of winter on the guihai day, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but could not take it; he was defeated by the Suolu and withdrew to Qiuyao. On the xinwei day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong and captured it. On the bingxu day, they again captured Tong Pass.
207
十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。 丁未，大赦天下。
On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suolu captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was captured. On the jiawu day, the troops sent by Prince of Suixiang Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it. On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left, was killed in battle with the Suolu at the Wei Wu garrison in Shouyang. On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
208
十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。 壬午，內外戒嚴。
On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, martial law was imposed throughout the court and realm. On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Cheng, General of Crossbowmen for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were killed in battle with the Suolu at Xuyi. On the gengwu day, the Suolu pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu. On the renwu day, heightened security was ordered throughout the court and realm.
209
二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。
On the bingxu new moon of the first month in spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat there was no court assembly. On the dinghai day, the Suolu withdrew from Guabu. On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi. That month, Wang Xuanmo, General Who Tranquilizes the North, withdrew from Qiuyao and returned to Lixia.
210
二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。 東作方始，務盡勸課。 貸給之宜，事從優厚。 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。
On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suolu fled in disorder from Xuyi. On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun are fiercely rampant, bringing hardship to several provinces; speaking of them with concern, I grieve whether waking or sleeping. The fierce Jie are wounded and broken; they flee in haste to distant places; the people they have maimed should be restored in timely fashion. In all commanderies and counties that suffered raids, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced. Spring plowing has just begun; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation. As to provisions for loans and grants, matters should follow a generous standard. Those who have drifted to the Jiang and Huai regions are all to be allowed to register where they are and granted remission of taxes and levies." On the jiaxu day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand General and concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes. On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Garrisons the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the Northern Center. On the renwu day, the Emperor visited Guabu; that day martial law was lifted.
211
三月乙酉，車駕還宮。 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。
On the yiyou day of the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace. On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province. On the gengzi day, Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yong Province. On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province. On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
212
夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer on the guiyou day, the state of Bada sent envoys bearing tribute goods. Shuang, the Suolu pretender General Who Pacifies the South, and Xiu, Secretariat Gentleman of the Suolu, submitted in allegiance. On the wuyin day, Shuang was appointed Inspector of Si Province.
213
五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。 [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。
On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city. On the dingsi day, the state of Bapo; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—all sent envoys bearing tribute goods. [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, took up the governorship of Southern Yan Province. On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Zhanzhi, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army. On the renzi day, Prince of Suixiang Dan, General of the Rear, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.
214
六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。
On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the Northern Center, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Fervor and Administrator of Qin commandery, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
215
秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。
On the jiachen day of the seventh month in autumn, the Eastern barbarian king of Wa, Wajin, was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
216
八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。
On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
217
冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。
On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, the state of Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
218
十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。
On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of Eastern Yan, Western Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji. That winter, displaced persons from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Gudu—together about ten thousand households.
219
二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。 今農事行興，務盡地利。 若須田種，隨宜給之。」
On the jiawu day of the first month in spring of the twenty-ninth year, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established, [38] and they have again met with flood disaster; hunger and distress have come one upon another. Quickly send orders to the various garrisons to relieve and support them generously. Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's profit. If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."
220
二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。
On the gengshen day of the second month, the Suolu ruler Tuoba Tao died. On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was created Prince of Jian'an.
221
夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer on the wuwu day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods. Zhang Yong, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Ji Province.
222
五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。 」是月，京邑雨水。
On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province. The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingchen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian foes follow a constant pattern; the cruel barbarian's extremity of evil has been manifest since old. Without troubling the battle-axe, he has already suffered Heaven's execution; sons and grandsons harm one another and kin and partisans are divided; the pretender chiefs of Tong and Luo all harbor inward submission, and the remnant people north of the Yellow River pour forth loyalty and request to serve. To rescue the drowning and sweep away filth—now is the time. Send orders to the two offices of the General of Agile Cavalry and the Minister of Works; each is to connect east and west according to what he commands. Those who submit in allegiance and establish merit are to be rewarded according to their labor." That month, the capital region suffered rain flooding.
223
六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。
On the jiyou day of the sixth month, the Department of State Affairs was sent on tour to grant firewood and grain and provide boats. Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army, led troops on the northern campaign. Liu Yu, Consulting Colonel of the Army Who Campaigns North, was appointed Inspector of Yi Province.
224
秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。
On the renchen day of the seventh month in autumn, Prince of Ruyin Hun was reassigned as Prince of Wuchang; Prince of Huaiyang Yu was reassigned as Prince of Xiangdong. On the dingyou day, the supervisory posts of the Grand Minister of Agriculture, Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent, and Director of Justice were abolished.
225
八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。
On the dingmao day of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiuyao but could not take it and withdrew.
226
九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。
On the dinghai day of the ninth month, Murong Shibin of the Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Qin and He provinces. On the jichou day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally appointed Inspector of Ji Province; Yan Province remained as before.
227
冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。
On the guihai day of the tenth month in winter, Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao but could not take it and withdrew.
228
十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。
On the renyin day of the eleventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Yang Province, died.
229
十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。
On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Grand General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, while retaining his post as Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
230
三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。 以南兗州并南徐州。 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。
On the wuyin day of the first month in spring of the thirtieth year, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Minister of Works and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Governor of Yang Province. Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province. On the gengchen day, Liu Zunkao, General Who Garrisons the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yu Province. On the renwu day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed General of the Guard and Governor of Jing Province. On the wuzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun commanded the mass of armies in campaigning against the Xiyang Man. On the guisi day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and General Who Garrisons the Army.
231
青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。
Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; on the renzi day of the second month, the Transport Department was sent to relieve and support.
232
甲子，上崩于含章殿。 時年四十七。 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。
On the jiazi day, the Emperor died in the Hall of Containing Splendor. He was forty-seven years old. His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong. On the guisi day of the third month, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum. When Shizu ascended the throne, he retroactively changed the posthumous title and temple name.
233
史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。 嗚呼哀哉！
The historian says: The Founder in his youth was uniquely gifted; though he had no strict tutors and protectors, Heaven bestowed a harmonious and keen nature, and he himself possessed the virtue of a ruler. When he took the throne facing south, his years were long; the framework of government was fully established, regulations and prohibitions clear and close, punishments had fixed statutes, and ranks of nobility had no indiscriminate grants. Therefore within was pure and without was tranquil; the four seas were at peace. Formerly the Eastern Han often spoke of the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; after that age as well, men regularly took the Yuanjia era as their standard—this was truly a flourishing age. When appointing generals and dispatching commanders, he went against the division of authority at the frontier gates; his talent fell short of Emperor Guangwu's, yet he remotely controlled military strategy—when it came to the day of battle, none failed to listen upward for the completed decree. Though armies were overturned and hosts lost, the generals were no Han Xin or Bai Qi; yet prolonging the enemy and bringing grievance to the borders—this too was the reason. When it reached the point that words leaked from the pillow and mat and trouble bound the merchant of old, though disaster arose beyond forethought, there was also cause for it to be so. Alas, how mournful!
234
校勘記
Collation Notes
235
車駕至京城孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。 京城則京口矣。 」按通鑑作建康。 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。
The imperial carriage reached the capital city — Sun Ao's Examination of the Song History says: "It should read capital metropolis. Capital city would then mean Jingkou." Comment: The Comprehensive Mirror reads Jiankang. In the Song History, capital city often refers to Jingkou city; here it refers to Jiankang.
236
辛未車駕祠南郊各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。
On the xinwei day the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb — all editions alike omit the two characters xinwei; supplemented according to the Southern History, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.
237
建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。
Administrator of Jian'an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed — Pan Sheng in all editions reads Pan Cheng; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.
238
乙卯各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。
On the yimao day — all editions read jimao; emended according to the Bureau edition and Southern History. Comment: That month the new moon was on dingyou day; the nineteenth day was yimao—there was no jimao.
239
領平北將軍南徐州刺史各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。
Concurrently General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province — all editions alike omit the character south; according to the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror, all read Governor of Southern Xu Province; now supplemented accordingly.
240
以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。 今據補。
Former Campaigning against Barbarians Staff Officer Yin Chong was made Inspector of Si Province — all editions alike omit the character Yin; according to the Suolu Monograph, at the time Yin Chong was Inspector of Si Province, as the Comprehensive Mirror also has it. Now supplemented accordingly.
241
征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張各本並脫「平」字。 據檀道濟傳補。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」
Grand General Who Campaigns South Tan Daoji defeated the Suolu at Dongping Shouzhang — all editions alike omit the character ping. Supplemented according to the biography of Tan Daoji. Hong Yixuan, Examination of Discrepancies in the Various Histories, says: "According to the biography of Tan Daoji it reads Dongping Shouzhang; here below east the character ping is omitted."
242
苟不深存務本各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。
If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs — all editions alike omit the character if; supplemented according to Yuance 198.
243
以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。 魏書作「慕利延」。
Murong Yan of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East — Murong Yan in this book's Tuyuhun monograph reads Mu Yan. The Wei History reads Muli Yan.
244
吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。
Huifa of the Tuyuhun was made General Who Garrisons the Army — all editions alike omit the character gu in Tuyuhun; supplemented according to the pattern of the text before and after. Huifa in the Wei History reads Weidai.
245
壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
On the renshen day the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting local products — King of Hexi in all editions reads King of Xihe; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor, year 1 of Jingping, and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
246
亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。
The outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Taishan — the Three Dynasties edition reads Taishan; the Hongzhi, Northern Supervisory, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read Qin and Liang.
247
夏四月乙酉按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。
In the fourth month of summer on the yiyou day — according to the calendar that month the new moon was on dinghai day; there was no yiyou. The twenty-third day was jiyou; yiyou is perhaps a corruption of jiyou.
248
秋七月辛酉「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。
In the seventh month of autumn on the xinyou day — xinyou in all editions reads yiyou; emended according to the Southern History. Comment: That month the new moon was on gengxu day; the sixth day was xinyou—there was no yiyou.
249
於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 」按孫說是，今訂正。 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。
In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established — all editions read In Yi Province the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Xinba, and Baxi were established. Sun Ao, Examination of the Song History, says: "According to the Monograph of Provinces and Commanderies, these are the three commanderies of Southern Jinsou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi." Comment: Sun's view is correct; now emended accordingly. Again, in this entry above it says renshen and below yihai. Comment: According to the calendar that month the new moon was on bingxu day; there was neither renshen nor yihai.
250
以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。 」按張說是，今改正。
Liu Zhendao, Colonel of Foot Soldiers, was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces — Liu Zhendao in all editions reads Liu Daozhen. Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes say: "It should read Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; below in year eighteen it also reads Liu Zhendao." Comment: Zhang's view is correct; now emended accordingly.
251
河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
The state of Henan and the King of Hexi and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products — King of Hexi in all editions reads King of Xihe; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
252
燕王弘遣使獻方物「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。
The Yan king Hong sent envoys presenting local products — Hong in all editions reads nian; emended according to the Jin History annals.
253
今年有不收處「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。
Places where this year there was no harvest — year in all editions reads half; emended according to Yuance 489.
254
以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」
Wang Qiu, Special Grandee, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing — Wang Qiu in all editions reads Wang Lin; emended according to the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror. Hong Yixuan, Examination of Discrepancies in the Various Histories, says: "Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a corruption of transmission."
255
夏五月壬午「壬午」各本作「壬申」。 局本作「壬午」。 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。 今從局本。
In the fifth month of summer on the renwu day — renwu in all editions reads renshen. The Bureau edition reads renwu. Comment: That month the new moon was on renwu day; there was no renshen. Now follow the Bureau edition.
256
尚書僕射王球卒「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。
Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Qiu died — Qiu in all editions reads Lin; emended according to the Southern History and Comprehensive Mirror.
257
是月各本並作十二月。 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。 今改作是月。
That month — all editions read twelfth month. Comment: Above there are already the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months; the twelfth month should not appear again. Now emended to read that month.
258
盛王聖世「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。
In a flourishing age and a sage reign — sage in all editions reads ancestor; emended according to Yuance 194.
259
始奉礿祠「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。
First performing the yue sacrifice — yue in all editions reads initial; emended according to Yuance 207.
260
庚申各本同。 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。 下有甲申，為十三日。 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。 庚申疑庚辰之譌。
On the gengshen day — all editions agree. Comment: That month the new moon was on renshen day; the third day was jiaxu—there was no gengshen in that month. Below there is jiashen, the thirteenth day. Between jiaxu and jiashen there is gengchen. Gengshen is suspected to be a corruption of gengchen.
261
南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西各本同。 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。
Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River — all editions agree. The Southern History after Southern Xu has the two characters Southern Yan.
262
南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。 今改作「駿」。
Governor of Southern Yu Province Jun, Prince of Wuling, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army — Jun in all editions reads Zan; the Three Dynasties edition reads tabooed name. Comment: At the time it was Prince of Wuling Jun—later Emperor Xiaowu. Zan was the ninth son of Emperor Ming; he too was later enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling, but at the time had not yet been born. Now emended to read Jun.
263
征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。
Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province — Governor of Southern Xu Province in all editions omits the character south; supplemented according to the biography of Yixuan.
264
九月己未「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。 今從局本。
In the ninth month on the jiwei day — jiwei in all editions reads yimao; the Bureau edition reads jiwei. Comment: That month the new moon was on dingsi day; the third day was jiwei—there was no yimao. Now follow the Bureau edition.
265
遷漢川流民於沔次「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。
Relocation of Han River refugees to the Mian shore. All editions read Han Province for Han River; no such province existed at the time—emended per Yuan gui 486.
266
三月丁巳下有乙丑。 各本同。 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。
Third month, dingsi day; yichou follows below. All editions agree. That month's new moon fell on dingmao—neither dingsi nor yichou is possible. Fourth month: new moon on bingshen; dingsi on the twenty-second day, yichou on the thirtieth.
267
辛亥各本並作「辛巳」。 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。 辛巳當作辛亥。 」今據改。
Xinhai [day]. All editions read xinsi. Zizhi tongjian Collation notes: "Per the long calendar, second-month new moon on renchen; xinchou on the tenth day, xinhai on the twentieth. Xinsi should read xinhai. Emended accordingly.
268
安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍「駿」宋本作「諱」。 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。
Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan, demoted to General Who Pacifies the Army. The Song edition has a taboo placeholder for Jun. The Sanzhao, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Hall editions read Zan; corrected per Emperor Xiaowu's annals. See collation note 30 in this scroll.
269
五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。 丁巳日支當有誤。
On yiyou of the fifth month, outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and held Liangzou; entries for dingsi (Pohuang), wuxu (Prince of Henan), and tribute missions follow. That year's fifth month began on jiashen—yiyou was day 2, wuxu day 15; dingsi cannot occur. The dingsi entry must be corrupt.
270
居業未立「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。
"Households had not yet established livelihoods": all editions read neng (able) for li (establish)—emended per Yuan gui 195.
271
戊午各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。 初九日戊午。
Wuwu day. All editions read gengwu; emended per Nanshi. That month opened on gengxu—gengwu is impossible. Wuwu fell on the ninth day.
